posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
One thing I can't figure out is why the planets aren't round.  The best I can figure is that it's to make clear what the planet's orientation should be when lining it up, but planets are round.  There has to be a better way to handle that.

Also, euro-blocks are cool and everything, but there's no way I'm playing a game like this, where you're adding life to planets and evolving them, without alien-shaped tokens to represent that, even if I have to make something myself.  Blocks and cylinders are far too dry for this Ameritrasher.
